caption:
🏙️ Copenhagen, every building standing today by year of construction — 1850 → 2025.

The old town in red is mostly 18th-century: the fires of 1728 and 1795 wiped out the medieval city. When the ramparts came down after 1856, the bridge districts of Nørrebro, Vesterbro and Østerbro filled in a few decades, then the 1930s housing blocks, and finally the new harbour districts of the 2000s.

📊 Data: Danish building register BBR / GeoDanmark via Københavns Kommune. About a third of the buildings shown (all of Frederiksberg, plus missing and decade-rounded years) have a year estimated from neighbouring buildings and district history. Heights exaggerated ×3.
🌍 Map: OpenStreetMap contributors.
